record.question: What is the purpose of the 'bluing' step after applying Mayer's Hematoxylin?
options: To shift the acidic stain to its blue alkaline form
record.explanation: Answer D: To shift the acidic stain to its blue alkaline form. After hematoxylin staining, alkaline bluing converts the reddish-purple nuclear stain to its characteristic blue color; it is not a separate counterstain or fixation step. Reference: https://www.merckmillipore.com/deepweb/assets/sigmaaldrich/product/documents/156/362/procedure-no-mhs-mayers-hematoxylin-solution-91930-ls-23-languages-mk.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
